KnowledgeRecord.title: Excel Layout Preservation
KnowledgeRecord.description: The system must preserve the original Excel file structure, empty rows, and layout when parsing or exporting billing.

KnowledgeRecord.title: Zero Net Pay Protection
KnowledgeRecord.description: Payroll submission must be blocked if net pay is zero or negative.

KnowledgeRecord.title: Insufficient Balance Block
KnowledgeRecord.description: The system must immediately block disbursement if the expense amount exceeds the current active balance.

KnowledgeRecord.title: VAT Split Rules
KnowledgeRecord.description: For Vatable suppliers, the exact Gross / 1.12 BIR formula must be used.

KnowledgeRuleReference.ruleDescription: The system must preserve the original Excel file structure, empty rows, and layout when parsing or exporting billing.
Payroll submission must be blocked if net pay is zero or negative.
The system must immediately block disbursement if the expense amount exceeds the current active balance.
For Vatable suppliers, the exact Gross / 1.12 BIR formula must be used.
